pairs.target: wū yà de huíxìn shì zài dé mǎ chūfā qiányìtiān xiàwǔ sòngdào de .
pairs.english: Wuya’s reply arrived on the afternoon before Dema’s departure.
pairs.hanzi: 乌娅的回信是在德玛出发前一天下午送到的。

pairs.english: Tavi returned from the washroom, his cuffs still wet. The messenger asked his name twice, then handed him an envelope thicker than usual.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维从洗物间回来，袖口还湿着。送信的人问了两遍名字，将一只比寻常厚些的纸封递给他。

pairs.english: The seal was pressed flat, with a water stain at one corner, already dry.
pairs.hanzi: 封口压得很平，角上有一块水迹，已经干了。

pairs.target: tā xiān kàn huíxìn chù . zhēn wān , méiyǒu cuò . cóng zìjǐ zài wěi jiē jìchū nà fēng suàn qǐ , yǐjīng guò le èrshíduōtiān .
pairs.english: He checked the return address first. Anvil Bay, correct. More than twenty days had passed since he posted his letter at Reed Steps.

pairs.english: A few days earlier he had been wondering whether to wait until Dema left, then inquire at the place where letters were received.
pairs.hanzi: 他前几天还在想，要不要等德玛走了，再去收信的地方问问。

pairs.target: tā tuō xià shī wàiyī dā zài yǐbèi , jiāng shǒu cāgān , cái chāi zhǐ fēng .

pairs.hanzi: 他脱下湿外衣搭在椅背，将手擦干，才拆纸封。

pairs.english: There were two letters in the envelope. The outer one was new; the inner one was folded small, its edges worn soft, its creases almost translucent.
pairs.hanzi: 纸封里有两封信。外面那张新，里面一张折得小，纸边磨软了，折痕几乎透光。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méi gǎn xiān chāi jiù de , jiāng wū yà xiě de nà zhāng tāndào chuángshàng .
pairs.english: Tavi did not dare unfold the old one first, spreading Wuya’s letter on the bed instead.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没敢先拆旧的，将乌娅写的那张摊到床上。

pairs.target: tā shuō shōudào xìn , cái zhīdào lán xiù tì shuí wèn . chāi chē de rén zěnyàng fāxiàn háizi , tā yǐjīng kàn míngbái le ; kě tā méi jiàn guò háizi zhǎngdà , niánsuì yě jì bùzhǔn , bùnéng zhī píng zhège shuō jiùshì tā .
pairs.english: She wrote that only his letter had told her whom Lanxiu was asking for. She understood how the dismantlers had found the child, but she had not seen him grow up and could not remember the age precisely, so could not identify him from this alone.
pairs.hanzi: 她说收到信，才知道岚绣替谁问。拆车的人怎样发现孩子，她已经看明白了；可她没见过孩子长大，年岁也记不准，不能只凭这个说就是他。

alignment.english: could not remember the age precisely

pairs.target: xiàmiàn de zì jǐ dé mì xiē .
pairs.english: The writing below was more crowded.
pairs.hanzi: 下面的字挤得密些。

pairs.target: wū yà méiyǒu zài huò yuàn yǐhòu zàijiàn guò fú lán . zhèjiàn shì méi biàn . dàn chèzǒu hòu de nàge chūntiān , tā shōudào guò fú lán yìfēngxìn , hòulái jiá zài jiùbān cè lǐ , gēn jǐzhāng huànbān de zhǐ shōu zài yìqǐ .

pairs.hanzi: 乌娅没有在货院以后再见过芙兰。这件事没变。但撤走后的那个春天，她收到过芙兰一封信，后来夹在旧班册里，跟几张换班的纸收在一起。

pairs.target: shàng huí xiěgěi lán xiù , tā zhī zhào jìde de shì huí le , yǐwéi shì zài bǔ jiù jìlù . zhècì kàn le tǎ wéi de xìn , cái qǐng rén bǎ nàxiāng jiù dōngxī cóng zhùchù bān lái , zhúyè zhǎo chūlái .
pairs.english: Last time, writing to Lanxiu, she had replied from memory, thinking she was completing an old record. After reading Tavi’s letter, she had someone bring the old box from her lodgings and searched page by page until she found it.
pairs.hanzi: 上回写给岚绣，她只照记得的事回了，以为是在补旧记录。这次看了塔维的信，才请人把那箱旧东西从住处搬来，逐页找出来。

alignment.english: searched page by page until she found it

pairs.target: tā shuō zìjǐ hěnjiǔméi yǒu ná qǐ tā , yě bù zhīdào fú lán hòulái yǒuméiyǒu zhǎo zhe háizi . dāngnián dàjiā bānláibānqù , xìn lǐ xiě de gōngfáng hòulái yě sàn le , bùnéng ná nàge dìzhǐ dàngzuò rújīn hái zhù zhe rén de dìfāng .
pairs.english: She said she had not picked it up for years and did not know whether Fulan had later found the child. People kept moving then, and the works named in the letter had dispersed too; that address could not be assumed to be inhabited now.
pairs.hanzi: 她说自己很久没有拿起它，也不知道芙兰后来有没有找着孩子。当年大家搬来搬去，信里写的工房后来也散了，不能拿那个地址当作如今还住着人的地方。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng xīn xìn zhé dào yìpáng , zhōngyú dǎkāi jiù zhǐ .

pairs.hanzi: 塔维将新信折到一旁，终于打开旧纸。

pairs.english: It began by asking whether Wuya’s leg injury had healed and whether the two people separated with her were safe.
pairs.hanzi: 开头问乌娅腿上的伤好了没有，又问她分走的两个人是否平安。

pairs.english: Not every word was easy to read. Water had blurred the ink in two places; Tavi looked back and forth but did not fill in the illegible words.
pairs.hanzi: 不是所有字都好认。有两个地方墨被水洇开，塔维来回看，仍没有把看不出的字补进去。

pairs.target: xìn lǐ yǒu yìxiǎo duàn xiě dé hěn zhí :
pairs.english: One short passage in the letter was very direct:
pairs.hanzi: 信里有一小段写得很直：

pairs.target: " ruò yǒurén lái wèn , yě qǐng gàosù tā , wǒ hái zài zhǎo . háizi chī dōngxī ài zuàn bù jiǎo , yèlǐ xǐng le biéjí zhe bào qǐ , xiān yìng tā yìshēng , tā tīngjiàn yǒurén jiù bù kū le .
pairs.english: “If anyone asks, please tell them I am still searching. The child likes to clutch a cloth corner when eating. If he wakes at night, do not hurry to pick him up; answer him first, and he will stop crying when he hears someone.
pairs.hanzi: “若有人来问，也请告诉他，我还在找。孩子吃东西爱攥布角，夜里醒了别急着抱起，先应他一声，他听见有人就不哭了。

pairs.target: ruò shízài gùbúguòlái , ràng rén shāohuà , wǒ qù . "
pairs.english: If you really cannot manage, send word. I will come.”
pairs.hanzi: 若实在顾不过来，让人捎话，我去。”

pairs.hanzi: 塔维坐在床沿，手慢慢放低。

pairs.hanzi: 屋外有人在拍被子，砰的一声，又一声。

pairs.hanzi: 他想起瑟拉夜里隔着半间屋应他，想起自己很小的时候，醒来不知身在何处，总要先听见一个人的声音。

pairs.english: But perhaps many children shared that habit. He could not remember anything earlier, and wanting to remember did not let him invent a memory he had never had.
pairs.hanzi: 可那也许是很多孩子都有的习惯。他想不起更早的事，不能为了想起，就给自己添一段从未有过的记忆。

pairs.hanzi: 他低头又读了一遍“我去”。那两个字挨得很近，后面拖出一点墨，像写信的人刚落笔，就让什么事情催着站起来。

pairs.target: tā bù zhīdào tā xiěxià zhè jù huà shí , lí huī ào yǒu duō yuǎn .
pairs.english: He did not know how far she had been from Ash Hollow when she wrote those words.
pairs.hanzi: 他不知道她写下这句话时，离灰坳有多远。

pairs.english: At dusk Mira and Iven came to fetch him for dinner; finding him sitting still, they first asked if he felt unwell. He said the letter had come and invited them in.

pairs.english: Mira dried her hands by the door and waited for him to hand over both letters before sitting at the table.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉将手在门边擦干，等他把两封信递过去，才坐到桌前。

pairs.target: yīwén kànjiàn yú wān de míngzì , táitóu wàng tā . tǎ wéi diǎntóu , shuō zhècì búshì zhī tīng biérén tíqǐ de huíchéng pái , tā zìjǐ yě zhēnde qù wèn guò . kě liǎngtiáolù zěnyàng jiē qǐlái , réng yǒu yíduàn bù zhīdào .

pairs.hanzi: 伊文看见榆湾的名字，抬头望他。塔维点头，说这次不是只听别人提起的回程牌，她自己也真的去问过。可两条路怎样接起来，仍有一段不知道。

pairs.target: mǐlā méiyǒu tì tā bǎ nà yíduàn tián shàng . tā dúwán jiù xìn , wèn sè lā zhīdào méiyǒu . " hái méi . " " nà xiān xiěgěi tā . fàn wǒ gěi nǐ liú . "
pairs.english: Mira did not fill that gap for him. Finishing the old letter, she asked whether Sela knew. “Not yet.” “Write to her first, then. I will save you dinner.”
pairs.hanzi:
米拉没有替他把那一段填上。她读完旧信，问瑟拉知道没有。
“还没。”
“那先写给她。饭我给你留。”

pairs.english: Tavi spread his paper and began by writing that Wuya’s reply had arrived today, enclosing Fulan’s original letter from those years.

pairs.english: He wanted to write that he was fine, but his pen paused, and he changed it to wanting to come home and show her.

pairs.english: Then he wrote that Dema was leaving for the station tomorrow; he would see her off first, then come home on his rest day in two days.
pairs.hanzi: 接着又写，明天德玛去测站，自己要先送她，过两天休息时再回。

pairs.english: Iven brought the lamp a little closer without standing behind him to read. Before leaving, Mira turned out the wet cuffs draped over the chair back so they would not stay folded shut.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文将灯挪近一点，没有站在后面读。米拉出去前，替他把搭在椅背上的湿袖口翻开，免得一直捂着。

alignment.english: brought the lamp a little closer

pairs.english: That night Dema came to say goodbye with her little bag already tied, asking from the doorway whether he could get up tomorrow morning.
pairs.hanzi: 夜里德玛带着已经扎好的小包来道别，站在门口问他明早能不能起。

pairs.target: tā dāying le . děng tā zǒu hòu , tā jiāng bēizi bǎizài ménbiān , hé zìjǐ de xié fàngzài yìqǐ , zhèyàng zǎoshàng kāimén jiù néng kànjiàn .
pairs.english: He agreed. After she left, he set the cup beside the door with his shoes, where he would see it when he opened the door in the morning.
pairs.hanzi: 他答应了。等她走后，他将杯子摆在门边，和自己的鞋放在一起，这样早上开门就能看见。
